title: Exploration of newly synthesized amantadine-thiourea conjugates for their DNA binding, anti-elastase, and anti-glioma potentials.
authors: Arshad, Nasima; Shakeel, Muhammad; Javed, Aneela; Perveen, Fouzia; Saeed, Aamer; Ahmed, Atteeque; Ismail, Hammad; Channar, Pervaiz Ali; Naseer, Fatima
one_liner_zh: 该文研究新合成金刚烷硫脲偶联物与DNA的结合及抗胶质瘤活性，虽涉及小分子-DNA互作和分子对接，但对象为小分子配体而非蛋白质-DNA体系，且方法以DFT/实验为主，与TF-DNA互作建模课题关联较弱。
abstract: Three newly synthesized amantadine thiourea conjugates namely MS-1 N-(((3 s,5 s,7 s)-adamantan-1-yl)carbamothioyl)benzamide, MS-2 N-(((3 s,5 s,7 s)-adamantan-1-yl)carbamothioyl)-4-methylbenzamide and MS-3 N-((3 s,5 s,7 s)-adamantan-1-ylcarbamothioyl)-4-chlorobenzamide were investigated for their structures, bindings (DNA/ elastase), and for their impact on healthy and cancerous cells. Theoretical (DFT/docking) and experimental UV-visible (UV-), fluorescence (Flu-), and cyclic voltammetry (CV) studies indicated binding interactions of each conjugate with DNA and elastase enzyme. Theoretically and experimentally calculated binding parameters for conjugate - DNA interaction revealed MS-3 - DNA to have most significant binding with comparatively greater values of binding parameters (K(b)/M(-1): docking, 3.8 x 10(5); UV-, 5.95 x 10(3); Flu-,1.55 x 10(5); CV, 1.52 x 10(4)), (∆G/ kJmol(-1): docking, -32.09; UV-, -22.40; Flu-,-30.81; CV, -24.82). The docked structures, greater bindings site size values (n), and the trend in DNA viscosity changes in the presence of each conjugate concentration confirmed a mixed binding mode of interaction among them. Conjugate - elastase binding by docking agreed with the experimental anti-elastase findings. Cytotoxicity studies of each tested conjugate demonstrated greater cytotoxicity for cancerous (MG-U87) cells in comparison to control, while for the normal (HEK-293) cells the cytotoxicity was found comparatively low. Overall exploration suggested that MS-3 is the most effective candidate for DNA binding, anti-elastase, and for anti-glioma activities.
abstract_zh: 三种新合成的金刚烷胺硫脲偶联物，即MS-1 N-(((3s,5s,7s)-金刚烷-1-基)氨基甲硫酰基)苯甲酰胺、MS-2 N-(((3s,5s,7s)-金刚烷-1-基)氨基甲硫酰基)-4-甲基苯甲酰胺和MS-3 N-((3s,5s,7s)-金刚烷-1-基氨基甲硫酰基)-4-氯苯甲酰胺，对其结构、结合（DNA/弹性蛋白酶）以及对健康细胞和癌细胞的影响进行了研究。理论（DFT/对接）和实验紫外-可见（UV-）、荧光（Flu-）和循环伏安法（CV）研究表明，每种偶联物与DNA和弹性蛋白酶存在结合相互作用。理论和实验计算的偶联物-DNA相互作用结合参数显示，MS-3-DNA具有最显著的结合，其结合参数值相对较大（K(b)/M(-1)：对接，3.8 x 10(5)；UV-，5.95 x 10(3)；Flu-，1.55 x 10(5)；CV，1.52 x 10(4)），（∆G/ kJmol(-1)：对接，-32.09；UV-，-22.40；Flu-，-30.81；CV，-24.82）。对接结构、较大的结合位点大小值（n）以及每种偶联物浓度存在下DNA粘度变化的趋势，确认了它们之间相互作用的混合结合模式。偶联物-弹性蛋白酶结合的对接结果与实验抗弹性蛋白酶发现一致。每种测试偶联物的细胞毒性研究表明，与对照组相比，对癌性（MG-U87）细胞具有更大的细胞毒性，而对正常（HEK-293）细胞的细胞毒性相对较低。总体探索表明，MS-3是DNA结合、抗弹性蛋白酶和抗胶质瘤活性的最有效候选物。
